facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jack reached the ground. He got an axe. He chopped the beanstalk. Jack chopped it down.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jack finally reached the ground safely. But the giant was still climbing down after him. Jack grabbed a sharp axe from his mother. He swung the axe at the beanstalk with all his strength. Jack chopped it down and it crashed to the ground. The giant fell back up into the clouds and was gone.
facts.Word cards: giant = 거인 / angry = 화난 / roared = 소리쳤다 / castle = 성
